items.title: Tell someone where I'm going
items.what: One tap sends a ready-made text saying which walk you're on, roughly when you'll be back, and a map link to where you are now, so the house knows where to look.
items.where: Recording screen (Create a new walk, or a walk's 'Walk this route'): the 'Tell someone where I'm going' button under the controls
items.inspiredBy: AllTrails Lifeline / Live Share and Strava Beacon

items.title: Daylight check
items.what: Each walk shows today's sunset and the latest time to head off to finish in daylight, and while you're walking the coach gives one heads-up when about 30 minutes of light are left.
items.where: Pick a walk (under the green 'Walk this route' button), and on the recording screen near sunset
items.inspiredBy: AllTrails and Gaia GPS sunset/daylight info

items.title: Punch combo call-outs
items.what: Optional Easy, Mixed or Hard combos (like '1-2-3: jab, cross, hook') called out every few seconds during each round and shown big on screen, kept quiet for the bell, halfway call and last 10 seconds.
items.where: Boxing timer setup: 'Call out punch combos during rounds'
items.inspiredBy: Precision Boxing Coach and Boxing Combo Timer
